<Subject 1> is the middle-aged Ming-dynasty official whose whole appearance comes from <Picture 1>: a tall black official hat with gold vertical ribs, gold cloud-shaped ornaments and two upturned wing flaps, a thin moustache with a short pointed goatee, and a deep red Ming official robe with a large gold dragon-and-cloud square badge on the chest, gold cloud embroidery on the shoulders and cuffs, and a wide gold-studded belt. <Subject 2> is the middle-aged Chinese man whose whole appearance comes from <Picture 2>: long straight black hair hanging past the shoulders, a small ornate gold crown with two long pins through it, a thin moustache and a narrow goatee, and a pale ice-blue robe with a white inner collar and dark blue embroidered swirl trim running down the lapel and around the cuffs. detailed_description:
Live-action footage shot on a long lens in tight close-up, shallow depth of field, soft overhead office light from slightly screen left, visible skin pores and single beard strands, fine film grain, and a flat grey-green wall behind both men. The four black border strips stay pure black and perfectly still in every frame.
[Shot 1] A tight close-up frames <Subject 2> at a slight three-quarter angle, his eyes turned to screen left and away from the lens, mouth slightly open as he listens. The gold crown, the long black hair falling past his shoulders and the top of a dark leather chair back sit behind his neck inside the frame. His head stays nearly still and only his eyes move; this shot lasts only eleven frames.
[Shot 2] At 00:00.458, the shot cuts to a tight close-up of <Subject 1> (S1), who begins speaking with his eyes turned to screen right. Around one second he brings his gaze back to screen left while his lips keep moving, and around three seconds he turns his eyes to screen right again, without stopping the sentence. His brows lift on the stressed words and his jaw works through each phrase, while the red robe and the gold dragon badge stay steady across his chest.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts back to <Subject 2>, now with his eyes wide, brows raised and mouth open, holding a stunned expression for about a second. He then pushes himself up out of the chair: his shoulders and head rise toward the lens while the camera stays locked on his face and does not tilt or pull back, so the dark chair back behind his neck slides down and out of the bottom of the frame. By the middle of the shot the chair is no longer visible behind him, and he keeps rising with his mouth open and his gaze fixed off the lens until the final frame.
Throughout all three shots the camera keeps only the slight handheld drift of <Video 1>, with no zoom, no reframing, no cutaway, and no other person entering the frame.
